title: دعوة لحضور المحاضرة تحت عنوان الجمعية التونسية لعلوم الفلك التاريخ والمستقبل

en.title: Invitation to the lecture "The Tunisian Astronomical Society: history and future"
en.excerpt: AUASS invites you to an online lecture on the history and future of the Tunisian Astronomical Society by its vice president, Hichem Ben Yahia, on 27 November 2022 at 7:30 pm Amman time.
en.body:
The Arab Union for Astronomy and Space Sciences is honoured to invite you to
the lecture entitled
The Tunisian Astronomical Society:
history and future
given by its vice president, Hichem Ben Yahia
Time: Nov 27, 2022 07:30 PM Amman
Time: Nov 27, 2022 4:30 PM GMT
